question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Rises'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 'When the temperature (1)______ during the summer season, many people choose to use air-conditioners to keep their homes and offices cool.' this sentence requires an appropriate word from the given options.
 
• The marked option 'rises' means to move upwards, to increase in amount.
 
• In this given context, the word' rises' fits well as it denotes that when temperature increases during the summer season, many people choose to use air-conditioners to keep their homes and offices cool.
 
• Thus, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank number 1 is** option 3.**
